description: This file contains the SaleDBUtil class, which provides database utility methods for managing sales, payments, feedback, and related entities within an online grocery ordering system. It includes methods to retrieve, update, and create sale records, as well as fetch sale details for receipts.

classes.name: SaleDBUtil
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for database operations related to sales, payments, feedback, and sale details.

methods.name: getAllSales
methods.description: Retrieves all sale records from the database, including associated payment, feedback, and customer details, returning a list of SaleDetails objects.

methods.name: UpdateEmID
methods.description: Updates the Employee ID (EmID) for a specific sale record, typically when accepted for delivery.

methods.name: UpdateStatus
methods.description: Updates both the order status and payment status to indicate delivery completion.

methods.name: createSale
methods.description: Creates a new sale record in the database with provided address, payment ID, customer ID, and total amount; returns the newly created sale's ID.

methods.name: getSaleDetailsByOrderID
methods.description: Retrieves detailed sale information for a specific order ID, including sale, customer, and cart product details, for receipt generation.
